title: 公園用の支柱式炭火グリル
description: 公園やピクニック場に置く支柱式炭火グリルの静的モデル。空の炭受け、側面・背面の風よけ、実際に隙間のある焼き網、三段の網支持金具、持ち手、吸気部と灰受けの引手を造形。食材・炭・炎は含みません。調理・耐熱・火災安全性は未検証で、動作や燃焼表現もありません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.704 × 1.075 × 0.634 m、17,808三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A static pedestal charcoal grill for parks and picnic areas, with an empty charcoal basin, side and rear windguards, genuinely open cooking grate, three-level grate support brackets, lifting handles, intake details and ash-drawer pull. No food, charcoal or flame is included. Cooking function, heat resistance and fire safety are not validated; no mechanical or combustion behavior is supplied. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.704 × 1.075 × 0.634 m; 17,808 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
